metadata.notes: Data operations are read-only, but the original shared preflight runs the OnchainOS npx installer. Rakazo adaptation must replace auto-install with a semantic capability requirement and use only an already installed/authorized tool.
Discovery/router itself states it does not sign or broadcast, but downstream protocol plugins may expose actions. Use discovery/analysis only in PAPER project.
Mixed read/write Skill: retain discovery, APY/TVL, positions and holdings analysis; exclude deposit/withdraw/claim/borrow/repay writes in PAPER adaptation.
Read-only public market ranking endpoints. Strong candidate for signal discovery and market-wide screening.
Read-only public token security audit. Suitable as one risk feature; LOW result is not a safety guarantee.

Keep public Smart Money feed, reports and backtest analysis. Strategy create/update/delete/follow operations must remain outside the default PAPER research path unless explicitly isolated as non-live control-plane work.
Keep public KOL/Smart Money tracking, replay and pattern analytics. Group/follow management is optional control-plane state and not required for read-only analysis.
Very useful PAPER architecture reference. Adapt to permanently disable live mode and order submission while retaining dry-run event logging, outcome sampling and post-mortem methodology.
Strong universal execution route. PAPER adaptation exposes market tier and optionally sandbox/testnet only; live trading/funds/implicitWrites remain unavailable.

Strong unified exchange Skill with public market data, --read-only and explicit --paper-trading. PAPER adaptation must never omit --paper-trading on write-like flows and must not mix live/demo credentials.
Useful cdcx paper simulator plus no-auth market data. PAPER adaptation keeps cdcx paper/market flows and excludes live trade/account/funds mutations.
Live Crypto.com APP trading/funds workflow requiring API keys. Retain only as architecture/reference; do not install into PAPER Project.
